title: Marcel Possible NDE 2339
content: When I was a child I had my tonsils removed. I remember being very scared the days before the surgery. The first thing I remember is that I had to inhale gas from a mask. Then I felt myself slipping (spiraling) in an unconscious state. Soon after that, I noticed that it was all yellow around me, a very warm yellow. I had a broader field of vision. I remember that I did not realize what happened to me, but I was very alert and curious. In the left corner, I could feel something warm and I heard beautiful music coming from it. Kind of New-Age, relaxing. To the right, I could clearly see a Mandala. This wheel rotated very slowly, but also, I had the feeling that this wheel could not be stopped, no matter what. A very solid, slow, relentless movement. This wheel had rings in it and they rotated in the wheel. Inside this rotating wheel, I saw small black figures, they rotated with this wheel. I remember I was fascinated and curious about these figures; they did not frighten me at the time of this experience. Next thing I remember is that I could see myself just from right above. I saw people dressed in green and a lot of blood. Next, I started to feel a lot of pain. I must have awoken too soon from the surgery. I left the table with a lot of blood in my mouth. But my parents gave me a cute Seagull doll and I was very happy again when I left the hospital! Background Information: Gender: Male Date NDE Occurred: 1981 approx. NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? Uncertain Surgery-related Other I awoke too soon from surgery. I awoke too soon from the surgery, as a child. How do you consider the content of your experience? Mixed Did you feel separated from your body? Yes I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal Somewhat more alert and very curious as to what happened. I was a child. I did not think that inhaling gas would result in this experience. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? It was the same during the experience. Were your thoughts speeded up? Neither Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Neither Were your senses more vivid than usual? More so than usual Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I had a much broader field of vision I estimate 180 degrees. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. But I heard familiar music, which was very relaxing. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere? Neither Did you pass into or through a tunnel? No Did you see any beings in your experience? Neither Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? Yes I saw, rotating within the wheel, several small black, abstract beings. I did not know what/who they were. Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin Did you see an unearthly light? Yes It was a warm, yellow light, all around me. Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? Unfamiliar, strange place What emotions did you feel during the experience? I was curious, amazed and very relaxed. Especially after the blackness after inhaling the awful smelling gas. Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Relief or calmness Did you have a feeling of joy? Happiness Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? United, one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? Everything about the universe Did scenes from your past come back to you? Neither Did scenes from the future come to you? Neither Did you come to a border or point of no return? Neither God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Moderate Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Moderate Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? Neither Did you see deceased or religious spirits? Neither Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? Uncertain I have never had a real relationship; I've noticed that the people here are very afraid when it comes to dealing with themselves; and the serious matters of life. As long as they have their work they are okay it seems. After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Uncertain I have always been extremely sensitive. This was also before this experience. I suffer from severe allergies and recently I can feel in what emotional state people are. This makes me very sad, because most people seem to be searching for something, and they are afraid of letting go. Most people are afraid of searching inside themselves; they cling to the familiar things they know. I do not contact them, however. Have you ever shared this experience with others? No Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was probably not real I forgot. What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real I can remember this experience more clearly than any other experience in my life. At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? No

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt himself slipping/spiraling into an unconscious state after inhaling gas.

arrival.other_being_detail: Several small black, abstract figures rotating within a slowly rotating mandala-like wheel.

environment.environment_other_detail: Warm yellow light all around; mandala/wheel rotating very slowly with rings rotating inside it; beautiful relaxing 'New-Age' music from a warm presence in the left corner.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Tonsil removal as a child; awoke too soon from surgery.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Mandala/wheel with small black abstract figures rotating; relaxing music; later pain and waking with blood in mouth.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Gas inhalation and spiraling/unconsciousness sensation, then warm yellow light/music/mandala with figures, then OBE viewing body/surgery scene, then pain and waking.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Prominent mandala-like rotating wheel with rings and small black abstract figures rotating within it; 'New-Age' relaxing music from a warm presence in the left corner.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “it was all yellow around me, a very warm yellow.”
